scope: All sharded QROS/RISE campaigns unless an explicitly preregistered campaign-specific policy supersedes this before economic outputs are read.
purpose: Make completed-shard promotion and first economic gate execution one deterministic serial transaction.
Prevent accumulation of an unevaluated economic queue while later GA1 shards continue running.
Keep cross-chat recovery deterministic and auditable.
Preserve multiplicity discipline through a frozen campaign-specific first-gate contract before any economic PnL is read.
primary_invariant: If any promoted GA1-complete shard has first_gate_status=PENDING, STARTING OR CONTINUING A NEW GA1 SHARD IS FORBIDDEN until the oldest pending promoted shard receives a durable terminal first-gate decision or an explicit BLOCKED_BY_INFRASTRUCTURE receipt.
shard_transaction: complete all GA1 groups for exactly one shard
write immutable GA1 shard completion receipt
append shard to promotion ledger with immutable first_gate_order
update frontier so that this shard is current_first_gate
execute the campaign-frozen first economic gate on this shard
persist full first-gate result and exposure receipt
record terminal first_gate_status PASS_FIRST_GATE, REJECTED_FIRST_GATE, INVALID_FIRST_GATE, or BLOCKED_BY_INFRASTRUCTURE
only then authorize the next GA1 shard

seed0076_binding.existing_backlog_rule: All GA1 work completed before activation remains scientifically valid because no economic PnL was read. Freeze the backlog and drain it FIFO before any new GA1 shard is executed.

backlog_transition.reason: Policy v1 accumulated promoted shards without economic execution. Policy v2 is activated before any Seed0076 economic PnL read.

failure_semantics.first_gate_integrity_failure: INVALID_FIRST_GATE and no next GA1 authorization
failure_semantics.missing_required_infrastructure: BLOCKED_BY_INFRASTRUCTURE only after attempted deterministic recovery is documented
failure_semantics.economic_failure: REJECTED_FIRST_GATE; preserve evidence; no rescue by management
